integrity: Entire proof, definitions and numerical tests supplied; finite numerical tests are corroborative only, not a proof or independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Euclidean projection onto real right circular cones; exact finite-dimensional constants are scalar variational formulas, and dimension-asymptotic optimal apertures need not minimize at finite dimensions. Historical priority is qualified by inspected sources.
title: Sharp aperture asymptotics of coordinatewise circular-cone projection
